searchText: Fixed on `kintsugi-spec` and `eip4399` branch (not on `beacon-ontopof-4399`) Issue was that the miner kept on mining the clique chain after ttd instead of just stopping Got some more tooling up for the testnets 😄 Forkmon: https://forkmon.merge-devnet-1.wenmerge.dev/ Execution block explorer: https://explorer.merge-devnet-1.wenmerge.dev/ Beacon chain explorer: https://beaconchain.merge-devnet-1.wenmerge.dev/ DM me if you need testnet ether asap, I'll get a faucet running soon-ish. Have a question about the strictly increasing json rpc ids. Is it expected that the CL persists the request id's across shutdowns? say the CL shuts down unexpectedly while the EL is processing `id=10`, will the EL reject my request if I restart from `id=1`? Thank you - confirmed there's no crash anymore.
